scripts.build: npm run vendor && npm run build:css
scripts.watch: npm run vendor && npm run watch:css
scripts.vendor: npm run vendor:js && npm run vendor:fonts
scripts.vendor:js: mkdir -p static/js && cp node_modules/htmx.org/dist/htmx.min.js static/js/htmx.min.js && cat node_modules/@alpinejs/collapse/dist/cdn.min.js node_modules/@alpinejs/focus/dist/cdn.min.js node_modules/@alpinejs/csp/dist/cdn.min.js > static/js/alpine.min.js && grep -v '^//# sourceMappingURL=' node_modules/lucide/dist/umd/lucide.min.js > static/js/lucide.min.js
scripts.vendor:fonts: mkdir -p static/fonts && cd node_modules/@fontsource-variable && cp geist/files/*-latin-*wght-normal.woff2 geist-mono/files/*-latin-*wght-normal.woff2 ../../static/fonts && for font in *; do cp $font/LICENSE ../../static/fonts/$font-LICENSE.txt; done
